Victims have been identified as Cuban immigrants who had fled Cuba. New video shows a survivor crawling from the plane and a person found alive in a crushed car near the crash site. NTSB recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders; initial flight data shows signs consistent with the pilots attempting a go-around before the crash, and investigators are examining whether the plane touched down too far down the runway to stop safely; the aircraft came to rest about 1,300 feet past the runway end. NTSB is set to interview the surviving pilots. All runways closed; FAA and NTSB continue investigating.
